name: Wyld Registration Sentry – Block Disposable Emails
author: Wyldcode - e-dimensionz, Inc

sections.description:
Fake and throwaway signups fill your user list with accounts nobody can reach. Wyld Registration Sentry checks each email address before the account is created, and blocks the ones that won’t work.

It checks registrations and email changes against the WyldAPI email validation service. You choose what gets blocked:

  • email domains that don’t exist or don’t resolve
  • domains with no MX records, so they can’t receive mail (always blocked)
  • disposable and temporary email services
  • free email services like Gmail or Outlook (optional, allowed by default)
  • top-level domains you pick from a list, like .xyz or .top (optional)

It also:

  • checks email changes made in wp-admin and through code, not just new registrations
  • keeps an activity log of blocked attempts that you can review in the admin
  • lets you decide whether signups go through or get blocked if the validation service is down or out of credits

You’ll find the settings under Settings > Wyld Registration Sentry. Signing up for WyldAPI gives you free credits to try it out.

External services

This plugin connects to the WyldAPI email validation service to validate email addresses during user registration and when users change their email address.

It sends the email address being validated to WyldAPI when a registration is submitted or when an email address is changed and the relevant validation checks are enabled in the plugin settings.

Service provider: WyldAPI
Terms of Service: https://wyldapi.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://wyldapi.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress, or upload the files to the /wp-content/plugins/wyld-registration-sentry directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Wyld Registration Sentry.
  4. Enter your WyldAPI API key. You can get a free one at https://console.wyldapi.com
  5. Choose which checks you want to use and save.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin need an external service?

Yes. Email validation runs through WyldAPI, so you need an API key. Signing up gives you free credits to start with.

What happens if the validation service is unavailable?

You choose. Signups can either be blocked or allowed through while the service is unavailable or your account is out of credits.

Can I allow free email providers like Gmail or Outlook?

Yes. Free email services are allowed by default. You can block them in the settings if your site needs business addresses only.

Can I see what was blocked?

Yes. Turn on Log Bad Attempts and blocked signups show up in the activity log on the settings page.

Does it only check new registrations?

No. It also checks email changes made in wp-admin and email changes made through code.

Is it available in my language?

You can help translate it at https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/wyld-registration-sentry
